messages:
mia_sales: Argentum sent final RFP; they asked for a capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, and POC pricing. Procurement wants packet by Thu EOD. can we triage?

noah_se: Are they asking for embeddings-only or chat + search? QPS? production deployment mode?

mia_sales: Theyre looking for chat assistant + semantic search. Peak ~80 qps for load tests, corpus ~200GB. POC can be hosted if we provide data residency controls; prod maybe private.

ravi_prod: For the matrix Ill include rows for Redwood-3B-quant and Redwood-7B-pt. Columns: streaming, tool-calls, embed-dim, max-context, kv-cache, quant-compat, recommended batch, fallback-policy, token-cost-per-1k. I can draft CSV today.

zoe_infra: Infrastructure note: sustaining 80 qps with p95 < 250ms needs Dedicated or reserved hosted nodes. Hosted POC estimate ~12k/week including load tests; Dedicated baseline ~18k/month. Private/on-prem requires separate integration and HSM adds one-time fees.

tess_security: From the questionnaire: they require SOC2 attestation, pen-test cadence, BYOK/HSM options, VPC peering, audit log retention choices. SOC2 covered; HSM is an add-on for Private. Ill prepare redlined answers and a sensitive-data rubric.

upload-bot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood/example/argentum/capability-matrix-draft.csv

noah_se: If HSM is required day-1 the POC timeline slips and likely moves to Private. POC can use customer-managed cloud KMS if they agree.

zoe_infra: POC checklist: VPC peering test, dataset upload via S3 presigned, enable prefix caching, ramp to 80 qps for 30m, collect p50/p95/p99 and cache hit rate.

ravi_prod: Ill add sample prompts and expected perf notes to the CSV.

tess_security: Uploaded redline + SOC2 summary: https://drive.redwood/example/argentum/security-qna-redline.docx

mia_sales: Action items: noah -> runbook+scripts; ravi -> final CSV + 1-page summary; tess -> final redline + attestation; zoe -> pricing blurb. Ill assemble and upload Thu EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:
